test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between F and G when counted from the left of G. A sits third to the left of E. C sits to the immediate right of E. C sits second to the left of F. B is an immediate neighbour of A. How many people sit between D and F when counted from the right of F?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between F and G when counted from the left of G.

A sits third to the left of E.

C sits to the immediate right of E.

C sits second to the left of F.

B is an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fefce0cff97351b812815457c444f3b282d979e9be8ca60af93bd39257cf345.png] 

So, all 5 people lie between F and D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
